facts: Desulfovulcanus ferrireducens Ax17 (DSM 111878) was cultured with synthetic two-line ferrihydrite.
Ferrozine spectrophotometry followed oxalate dissolution. Samples were measured unfiltered and after 0.22 micrometre PES filtration before dissolution.
Matched uninoculated treatments were incubated at 55 degrees Celsius or room temperature.
FeCl2 and cysteine were present, so abiotic reduction/background requires controls.
Extracted Fe(II) is reported in mM. This assay measures an extraction-defined Fe(II) pool, not a mineral-phase identity.
No numerical organism outcome is imported into the assay record.
